name: employee-pretends
prompt: Create a funny 30-second animated video about an employee who pretends to work whenever his manager walks past.

message.hook: Dave is laughing at a cat video at 9 AM. Footsteps.
key_points: Gag 1 (9:00 AM): cat video -> manager walks past -> instant spreadsheet + fake typing -> 'Crunching numbers, boss!'
Gag 2 (11:00 AM): asleep at the desk -> footsteps -> snaps into a 'thinking' pose -> 'Visualizing synergy.'
Gag 3 (4:59 PM, the pattern breaks): Dave slaps the monitor OFF to hide the video and types furiously -> 'Dave. Your monitor is off.'
Twist: the CEO walks past and the manager does exactly the same thing: 'Crunching numbers, sir!'

cast.dave: the employee (blue hoodie), seated bust behind his desk, foreground right
cast.omar: the manager (navy suit, red tie), walks the corridor behind the desk, back-left plane
cast.rex: the CEO (black suit, gold tie), walks past on the far plane in the final beat, no lines

sets: BM.ENV.office (floorY 1330) as the single comedy stage
three title cards (11:00 AM, 4:59 PM, end card) on flat colour with a rotating sunburst
props: monitor (screen states: cat video / spreadsheet / off)
plant + water cooler + clock from the set
style_brief: Bang Motion cartoon pack: warm cream office, flat characters, Fredoka subtitles with yellow karaoke highlight, Bangers onomatopoeia. Motion signature: fast snaps (0.15-0.25 s) into held reactions (>= 0.6 s), camera punches on every 'caught' moment, a slow handheld drift so no frame is static, iris/wipe time-skip cards, comic slam into the end card. Staging for 9:16: monitor screen and Dave's face share the middle of the frame, the manager's path runs behind them so the audience always sees both the lie (screen) and the liar (face).

storyboard.visual: Tight on Dave laughing at a cat video on his monitor
Omar walks in on the back plane from the left; Dave hears the footsteps, eyes dart, screen flips to a spreadsheet, fake typing
Omar waves; Dave thumbs-up with a nervous grin
Omar walks off right behind the desk; beat; Dave peeks, sly grin, cat video back on
Dave asleep at the desk (zzz). Footsteps. Eyes snap open, instantly into a 'thinking' pose, spreadsheet back
storyboard.camera: slow push on the sleeper, punch at the snap

storyboard.visual: Omar hands on hips: 'Deep in thought?' Dave, smug: 'Visualizing synergy.'
Omar confused (?), shrugs and leaves; Dave sparkles proudly
Cat video again; footsteps; Dave slaps the monitor OFF and types furiously, sweating
Omar deadpan, arms crossed: 'Dave. Your monitor is off.' Snap zoom on the black screen, crickets. Dave: 'It's a power saving spreadsheet.'
storyboard.camera: punch on the black monitor 22.35, back wide
storyboard.text: Dave. Your monitor is off. / It's a power saving spreadsheet.

storyboard.visual: Heavy footsteps: Rex the CEO strides past on the far plane. Omar does a full take and points at Dave's dead screen: 'Crunching numbers, sir!' Dave types along. Rex nods and walks on.
storyboard.camera: shake on the thuds, punch on Omar's take

storyboard.visual: Comic slam into a yellow card: EVERYONE'S BUSY.

publish._note: Publishing is intentionally not wired. Human review first.
